label: fact
about: The files the Storm Charles flight map reads (data.promptugal.news /storm/): airline flights by callsign, the 10 m wind, runways and METAR winds, and the base maps. Made by scripts/storm-flights-map.mjs from storm/charles/data/flights/ (itself from the Storm repository at commit fdac6ed, Apache-2.0).
attribution: Aircraft positions: adsb.lol (https://adsb.lol), ODbL 1.0, as kept by the Storm Charles site
Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com), CC BY 4.0
Base maps: Natural Earth, public domain. Runways: OurAirports, public domain.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
